title: The BGMs with interactive sound: data/sound/interactive_music.json
description: The BGM info archive (a/0/8/6, bgm_info.c): the BGMs that the field's interactive sound system (src/system/iss_*.c) changes while they play, and how. A BGM that isn't listed plays as it is. tools/data/sound_data.py packs it in this order.

system.description: road fades tracks 8 and 9 in while the player moves and out while they stand still; city sets tracks 8 and 9 by the player's distance to the town's sound sources; dungeon changes the pitch of the other tracks by the zone's settings; 3d_sound plays tracks from places on the map; switch and zone turn tracks on and off by place, from their own archives
